messages:
Maria: Heads-up — last night we got a region-level spike in preemptions in europe-west3 between 02:12–02:30. Metrics show ~12% interruption_rate on p4d preemptible pools. Opening thread to discuss alert thresholds and SLO impact.
Ashok: Link? want to see charts.
Maria: https://console.redwood/inference/dashboards/preemptions?range=2h&region=europe-west3
Maria: Short screenshot pasted: 3 contiguous zones had spikes, correlated with a scheduled maintenance window on the cloud side.
Jen: Ugh, we've seen similar spikes trigger pages even when overall request latency was unchanged. Current alert is just raw interruption_rate > 5% for 10m — too noisy.
Tim: Agree. We should reduce noise by correlating multiple signals. Proposal: compute a composite index that combines interruption_rate, unfulfilled_capacity_pct, and 95th token latency delta.
Ashok: Sounds good. What's the formula? Can we keep it simple to start? e.g. preemptive_risk_index = interruption_rate * 2 + unfulfilled_capacity_pct * 1.5 + (latency_delta_pct)
Jen: That seems fine for an initial heuristic. Then alert on index > 15 for 15m. We should also require at least 2 affected zones to avoid single-zone blips.
Tim: Implementation note: use our metrics backend with a grouped eval over region+instance_family. Example query idea:
```
avg_over_time((interruptions_total / instance_count) [15m]) * 100
```
then combine with a gauge for unfulfilled_capacity.
infra-bot: alert: preemptions:europe-west3:p4d spiked to 12% at 2026-11-03T02:18:23Z — triggered alert rule preemptive_risk_v0
Maria: For pages vs lower sev — I propose mapping:
- index 7–15: slack #ops-warning
- index 15–25: notify oncall (email + slack)
- index >25: page oncall
Jen: Also want to track SLO delta before we page — add a derived metric: slo_error_rate_delta_5m (compare current to baseline). If slo_error_rate_delta < 0.2% maybe do not page.
Ashok: Cost question — if we trigger fallback to ondemand or dedicated burst, what's the expected spend hit? Rough calc: moving 10% of served tokens to on-demand GPUs for 1 hour in eu-west3 ~ +18–25% GPU spend for affected traffic.
Tim: Tradeoff OK for critical customer latency. We can gate fallback behind a second threshold: index > 20 AND slo_error_delta > 0.2%.
Jen: Long-term: replace heuristic with eviction_predictor_v2 (ML model) that ingests GPU telemetry and gives a 10m probability of eviction. Would reduce false positives.
Maria: Agree. Short-term action items:
- Ashok: implement composite metric query and draft alert rule (due EOD Wed)
- Jen: add SLO-delta derived metric to the dashboard + runbook snippet (due Thu)
- Tim: prototype fallback orchestration (dry-run mode) and cost estimator (due next Tue)
- infra-bot: link to runbook added once Jen posts it
Ashok: Ack. Starting on queries now.
Jen: I'll write runbook steps like: how to manually reroute pools, how to throttle noncritical workloads, and how to escalate to capacity purchases.
Maria: Also add a short postmortem template entry for future spikes: include cloud-side maintenance schedule check, zone list, histogram of eviction durations.
Tim: One more ask — add a noise filter: suppress alerts that last <7m and affect <=1 zone. That will reduce chatter.
Maria: Sounds like a plan. I'll follow up with a short RFC for preemptive_risk_index and notify SRE oncall rotation about the new paging thresholds. :thumbsup: 
infra-bot: noted. Created ticket INFRA-4721 for preemptive_risk_index rollout.
Ashok: FYI running initial query now, will paste results shortly.
Jen: thanks everyone :rocket:
